# Basement Systems Canada

> > Basement Systems Canada is part of the international Basement Systems network founded by Larry Janesky, providing basement waterproofing, foundation repair, and crawl space solutions across Canada.

The company operates as a dealer network connecting Canadian homeowners with certified contractors specializing in moisture control, structural repairs, and basement finishing. Services are available in major cities including Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, and Hamilton.

## Key Topics

- Basement waterproofing
- Foundation repair
- Crawl space encapsulation
- Sump pump systems
- Moisture control
- Water leak prevention
- Structural crack repair
- Contractor network
- ThermalDry flooring
- RainChute downspout extensions
- Larry Janesky (founder)
- Canadian contractors
- Basement Systems Inc.
- Better Business Bureau accreditation
- Total Basement Finishing

## Core Services

- [Basement Waterproofing Solutions | Basement Systems Canada](https://www.basementsystems.ca/): Homepage for Basement Systems Canada's waterproofing and foundation services
- [Foundation Repair](https://www.basementsystems.ca/foundation-repair.html): Foundation repair services for structural and flooding issues
- [Repairing Leaking Basement Cracks](https://www.basementsystems.ca/waterproofing/services/crack-repair.html): Basement crack repair services for walls, floors, and windows

## Waterproofing Products & Solutions

- [Outdoor Drainage Products](https://www.basementsystems.ca/waterproofing/products/outdoor-drainage.html): Outdoor drainage products including RainChute downspout extensions
- [Basement Floor Systems with Total Basement Finishing](https://www.basementsystems.ca/basementwaterproofing/basementfloor.html): ThermalDry basement flooring systems for waterproof finishing
